_readme: Published US store-count estimates for the chains this project cannot count from a first-party
locator. Hand-typed from trade press and dated, NOT measured — a yardstick for how much of each
chain the sightings capture, never added to any collected total. Collected chains carry no
estimate: their own locator IS the count, so they are complete by construction. Where no
credible US total is published, the estimate is a dated, low-confidence range and says so.

heytea.note: Revised up from a stale trade-press 28: this project's permit-sourced count already reaches 30. App-only nationally, so a few outlets in un-permit-watched metros may remain.

taier.source: first-party enumeration (Yelp official pages, order.online, taierusa)
taier.note: Complete US set as of 27 Sep 2026: San Mateo, Santa Clara (Valley Fair), Arcadia, Flushing. The earlier '5' double-counted Arcadia and 'LA' (the same store).

yangs.note: chain in retreat; most US stores have closed

nayuki.note: US entry Oct 2025; no published US total

chabaidao.note: US set enumerated ~5 as of Sep 2026 (Flushing, Palo Alto, San Jose, Irvine, Bellevue); still expanding, though Canada (Richmond BC, Toronto) is the bigger current growth.

yangguofu.source: FDD Item 20 (23 at 31 Dec 2025) + web enumeration
yangguofu.note: Revised down from ~45: that figure was the FDD's forward projection of ~37 new 2026 outlets, most of which have not opened or are not findable. 26 held (the 23-outlet FDD roster plus Arcadia, Duluth, Sunrise); still expanding, so a few 2026 openings are likely unfound.

fishwithyou.note: Revised down from ~15-25, which extrapolated from the ~2,700-store global scale. Exhaustive harvesting (regional sites, delivery apps, Yelp) finds 11, and the chain's own US site lists only a few; the US footprint is small.

zhangliang.note: Revised down from ~25: the brand's own '42 across North America' figure includes Canada and Mexico. Exhaustive US harvesting finds 17 (16 mapped + Sacramento); a few more US outlets may exist.

chahalo.note: Recent US entry; 3 confirmed open (City of Industry, Berkeley, NYC) plus Plano TX announced. Toronto is in Canada.

xiaolongkan.note: The chain's own US site lists 8 open outlets plus 4 coming soon (Houston, Bellevue, Costa Mesa, San Diego) as of 28 Sep 2026.
